hooks.command:
echo `# <#` >/dev/null
sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" session
exit $?
#> > $null
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$root = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
if (-not $root) { $root = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }
& "$root/hooks/run.cmd" session
exit $LASTEXITCODE

echo `# <#` >/dev/null
sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" post
exit $?
#> > $null
$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
$root = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"
if (-not $root) { $root = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }
& "$root/hooks/run.cmd" post
exit $LASTEXITCODE
